boundary: This queue schedules human review only. It never changes page verification, indexing, status, or publication flags.

items.focus: Governance modes, authority, validation, replication boundary, and release/deployment limitations.
review_gates: Confirm the page scope matches the reviewed claims and does not imply broader product coverage than the evidence supports.

Check that human and machine-readable routes tell the same story.
Check local links, source references, and terminology before any publication decision.
